title: Command Words
author: 661cee569e09001be06aff2c
chapter_outcomes: phân tích: examine in detail to show meaning, identify elements and the relationship between them
bình luận: give an informed opinion
so sánh: identify/comment on similarities and/or differences
Miêu tả: state the points of a topic / give characteristics and main features
Thảo luận: write about issue(s) or topic(s) in depth in a structured way
đánh giá: judge or calculate the quality, importance, amount, or value of something
giải thích: set out purposes or reasons / make the relationships between things clear / say why and/or how and support with relevant evidence
Nêu ra: produce an answer from a given source or recall/memory
Lý giải: support a case with evidence/argument
Tuyên bố: express in clear terms
gợi ý: apply knowledge and understanding to situations where there are a range of valid responses in order to make proposals / put forward considerations
